question_text: You are entering a public road e.g. from a field or building site and considerably soil the road. Who is responsible for eliminating this traffic obstruction?

options.text: You, as you have caused it
The persons living along this section of the road

correct_answers.text: You, as you have caused it

comment: If you significantly pollute a road due to leaving an unpaved area, then you, the polluter, must clean it.

question_text:
What must you do to avoid endangering others by equipment or load which has fallen off your vehicle?
Depending on the situation,

options.text: - secure the danger spot and immediately inform the road service or police
- proceed and inform the nearest municipal office

correct_answers.text: - secure the danger spot and immediately inform the road service or police

comment: You must immediately remove any objects from the roadway that have fallen down and endanger other road users. Secure the danger zone. If necessary, contact the police or road services.
